_comment: TEMPORARY (2026-08-11): switched primary from claude_sonnet to azure_gpt5_mini because this deployment's Azure subscription has 0 quota for every Claude model in every region (Global Standard and DataZone Standard both confirmed 0 via `az cognitiveservices usage list`), while azure_gpt5_mini has a real GlobalStandard deployment and non-zero quota (500 TPM-thousands). Claude Sonnet 4.6 remains the intended permanent primary per the original rationale below once Claude quota is approved — this is a stopgap, not a reversal of that decision, and should be reverted (provider_chain back to ["claude_sonnet", "pdfplumber"]) once Claude Sonnet/Haiku deployments exist again. Original rationale, still accurate for when Claude is restored: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (claude_sonnet_client.py) is the permanent primary extraction engine — single whole-document call (no page splitting), validated across all 4 sample vendor statements (69-602 rows), column-agnostic mapping that correctly disambiguates vendors with multiple invoice-number-like columns, and (as of the vendor_name/statement_date prompt fix) reliable document-level vendor_name extraction. Supersedes both azure_doc_intel and Gemini as primary (see RULES.md RULE-04 for the fuller provider history). Deterministic pdfplumber (with internal OCR fallback for scanned pages) remains the non-AI last resort, unchanged. Gemini and Mistral are kept registered in provider_config_paths as alternate/fallback options — accessible directly via get_ai_client() — but are not part of the active chain. claude/azure_gpt5_*/azure_doc_intel config paths remain registered for the same reason.
